correctness.rationale: From the 3-deck one recovers each same-start four-run word using mixed triple counts and symbol totals. For opposite starts the resulting parameter equations reduce to ad t(t−1)=0 with strictly positive a,d,t, forcing a fair reversal. Four elementary double-count identities yield sufficiency; the unequal 0010/0100 counts separate every reversal at order four. The exact divisor count is a bijective parameter count. The standalone verifier exhaustively confirms this on all at-most-four-run words of lengths up to 28 and checks four-decks through 24, but the proof, not finite testing, establishes unbounded n.

value.rationale: The natural source class is defined by a bounded number of constant runs. The theorem classifies every ambiguous three-deck fibre at every length, yields a concrete exact integer-divisibility census, and determines the optimum in-class zero-error code size. The necessity restriction and complete fibre size distribution are substantially more informative than a reconstruction threshold, and the work acknowledges earlier threshold and fairness results.
